limitations: The theorem concerns labeled empty/mixed/full edge approximations on k-uniform loose hypercycles (k>=3,r>=3), not arbitrary hypergraphs, random nonuniform vertex weights, or equivalence-relation-based rough hypergraph variants. title: Sharp ambiguity hierarchy for edge rough observations on uniform loose hypercycles
